Daangaan kanaan dura ture kun hojii dooniiwwan waraanaa Yukreenirratti dhiibbaa umee ture, amma garuu guutummaatti sirreeffameera. Rakkoon kun kan uumame, Yukreen buufataalee qulqulleeffannaa boba'aa Raashiyaarratti haleellaa geggeessuu isheetin walqabatee, mootummaa Yukreen fi Ameerikaa gidduutti mariin siyaasaa erga uumamee booda.

title: British woman dies after trying to rescue sons swept away at sea in the Bahamas
english: A 36-year-old British woman has died in the Bahamas after trying to save her two sons who were carried away by strong currents while snorkeling. Although the children were successfully rescued from the water, the mother could not be revived after being brought to shore. Local authorities are investigating the incident, though they do not believe foul play was involved.
amharic: በባሃማስ በባህር ዳርቻ ስትዋኝ በነበረችበት ወቅት ልጆቿን በኃይለኛ የውሃ ሞገድ ተወስደው ለማዳን የሞከረች የ36 ዓመት እንግሊዛዊት ሴት ህይወቷ አልፏል። ሁለቱ ልጆች በደህና ከውሃው ቢወጡም እናታቸው ግን ህይወቷን ለማዳን የተደረገው ጥረት ሳይሳካ ቀርቷል። የባሃማስ ፖሊስ ክስተቱን እየመረመረ ሲሆን ወንጀል የተፈፀመበት ምንም አይነት ምልክት አልታየም።
oromo: Bahamaas keessatti haati lammii Ingilizii umuriin ishee waggaa 36 ta'e, ijoollee ishee lamaan bishaan harka irraa fudhate oolchuuf yaaltu irratti lubbuun ishee darbeera. Ijoolleen kun bishaan keessaa nagaan oolfamaniiru, garuu haati kun erga bishaan keessaa baafamtee booda du’uu ishee doktoroottan mirkaneessaniiru. Poolisiin Bahamaas balaa kana qorachaa jiru, garuu gocha shakkisiisaa ta'e tokkollee hin jiru jedhaniiru.

title: FIFA’s Infantino touts global re-election support amid resignation questions
english: FIFA President Gianni Infantino is confident about securing a fourth term in office through 2031 despite previous calls for his resignation over a failed commercial project. He recently received significant support from the Asian Football Confederation and other international associations, which has effectively silenced his critics. As the nomination deadline approaches in November, he remains the clear frontrunner with no credible opposition emerging to challenge his leadership.
amharic: የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ ቀደም ሲል ከነበረባቸው የሥራ መልቀቅ ግፊት እና ውድቅ ከሆነው የንግድ ፕሮጀክት ጋር በተያያዘ ችግሮች ቢኖሩም እስከ 2031 ድረስ በአራተኛ የምርጫ ዘመን ለመቀጠል ያላቸውን እምነት ገልጸዋል። በቅርቡ የእስያ እግር ኳስ ኮንፌዴሬሽንን ጨምሮ ከተለያዩ ዓለም አቀፍ ማህበራት ያገኙት ድጋፍ ተቃዋሚዎቻቸውን ዝም እንዲሉ አድርጓቸዋል። በኖቬምበር ወር በሚጠናቀቀው የእጩነት ማቅረቢያ ጊዜ ምንም አይነት ጠንካራ ተፎካካሪ ባለመኖሩ ኢንፋንቲኖ ለምርጫው በግንባር ቀደምነት ይጠበቃሉ።
oromo: Pirezedantiin FIFA Jiyaanii Infantinoo, kanaan dura dhiibbaa hojii gadhiisuu fi sagantaa daldalaa fashaleen walqabatee rakkoolee mudatanis, hanga bara 2031tti aangoo isaanii itti fufuuf of amanamummaa qabu. Dhiheenya kana Gamtaa Kubbaa Miillaa Eeshiyaa dabalatee gamtaalee addunyaa gara garaa irraa deeggarsa argachuun isaanii, namoota isa morman callisiiseera. Yeroon dorgommii dhiheenya kan xumuramuu fi dorgomaan cimaan waan hin jirreef, Infantinoon bakka guddaa qabatanii dorgommichaaf qophaa'aniiru.

title: Iran says won’t allow US warships to get close as Trump ponders new attacks
english: Iranian military leaders have warned that they are ready to attack any US warships that approach their territory, dismissing recent threats from President Donald Trump. While the US considers launching new strikes or maintaining a naval blockade, Iran claims its defense capabilities remain strong enough to prevent American ships from entering the region. This escalating tension, combined with ongoing Iranian attacks on tankers near the Strait of Hormuz, has caused a significant spike in global oil prices.
amharic: የኢራን ወታደራዊ መሪዎች ማንኛውም ወደ ግዛታቸው የሚጠጋ የአሜሪካ የጦር መርከብ ላይ ጥቃት ለመሰንዘር ዝግጁ መሆናቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አዳዲስ ጥቃቶችን ወይም የባህር ላይ እገዳን እያጤኑ ቢሆንም፣ ኢራን የአሜሪካ መርከቦች ወደ አካባቢው እንዳይገቡ ለመከላከል የሚያስችል አቅም እንዳላት ገልጻለች። ይህ እየተባባሰ የመጣ ውጥረት እና በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ አቅራቢያ የሚገኙ መርከቦች ላይ የሚሰነዘረው ጥቃት የአለም የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንዲጨምር አድርጓል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni waraana Iraan dooniiwwan waraana Amerikaa gara daangaa isaanii dhihaatan kamiyyuu irratti haleellaa raawwachuuf qophii ta'uu isaanii ibsaniiru. Preezidaant Doonaald Tiraamp haleellaa haaraa ykn uggura galaana irratti hundaa'e raawwachuu irra deddeebi'anii kan yaadan ta'us, Iraan dooniiwwan Amerikaa naannichatti akka hin dhihaanne ittisuuf humni ishee gahaa ta'uu dubbatti. Walitti bu'iinsi kun fi haleellaan dooniiwwan boba'aa 'Strait of Hormuz' keessatti raawwatamu, gatiin boba'aa addunyaa akka olka'u godheera.

title: Jordan’s King Abdullah orders firm response after deadly church attack
english: King Abdullah of Jordan has called for a strong crackdown on the perpetrators of a deadly shooting at a Greek Orthodox church in Karak that left eight people dead and many injured. The government has condemned the assault as an act of extremist terrorism and has increased security measures across the country while the search for the gunmen continues. In response to the tragedy, the nation has declared three days of official mourning to honor the victims of the attack.
amharic: የዮርዳኖሱ ንጉሥ አብዱላህ በካራክ በሚገኝ የግሪክ ኦርቶዶክስ ቤተ ክርስቲያን ላይ የተፈጸመውን እና ስምንት ሰዎችን የገደለውን አስከፊ ጥቃት ተከትሎ ጥብቅ እርምጃ እንዲወሰድ ትእዛዝ አስተላልፈዋል። የሀገሪቱ መንግሥት ጥቃቱን የጽንፈኛ አሸባሪዎች ድርጊት ሲል የኮነነ ሲሆን፣ አጥቂዎቹን የማደን ስራው እየተከናወነ ባለበት በዚህ ወቅት በአገር አቀፍ ደረጃ የጸጥታ ጥበቃው ተጠናክሯል። ለተጎጂዎች መታሰቢያነትም በሀገሪቱ የሦስት ቀናት የሐዘን ቀን ታውጇል።
oromo: Mootichi biyya Jordaan Abdullah, qamadii karaa Kaaraak argamu tokko irratti namoota saddeet ajjeesee hedduu madeesse kana booda, tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhatamu ajajaniiru. Mootummaan biyyattii haleellaa kana 'gocha shororkeessummaa' jechuun balaaleffatee, yeroo ammaa ajjeestota barbaaduu fi nageenya biyyattii eeguuf sochii guddaa taasisaa jira. Balaa kana hordofees, biyyattiin guyyoota sadiif gadda biyyaalessaa labsiteetti.

title: France protests live: 135 arrested as marches held under tight security
english: France has mobilized a massive police force to manage a new wave of protests centered on living costs and school funding. Security measures have been tightened across the country to avoid the destruction seen in recent riots, resulting in 135 arrests so far. Officials in Paris have restricted the demonstration routes to the city's outskirts to keep crowds away from the central areas.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ በኑሮ ውድነት እና በትምህርት ቤት በጀት ላይ የሚነሱ ተቃውሞዎችን ለመቆጣጠር በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ የፖሊስ አባላትን አሰማርታለች። ቀደም ሲል የታዩትን የጥፋት ድርጊቶች ለመከላከል ጥብቅ የፀጥታ እርምጃዎች የተወሰዱ ሲሆን እስካሁን 135 ሰዎች በቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል። በፓሪስ የሚገኙ ባለስልጣናት ህዝባዊ ሰልፎቹ ከከተማው ማዕከል እንዲርቁ እና በከተማዋ ዳርቻዎች ብቻ እንዲወሰኑ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Faransaay gatii jireenyaa fi baajata manneen barnootaa irratti mormii ka'e to'achuuf poolisoota kumaan lakkaawaman bobbaasteetti. Miidhaa darbe irra deebi'amee akka hin mudanneef eegumsi cimaan godhamee, hanga ammaatti namoonni 135 to'annoo jala oolaniiru. Aangeyyoonni Paaris mormiin kun bakka jiddu galeessa magaalaa irraa fagaatee daangaa magaalaa qofa irratti akka daangeeffamu godhaniiru.

title: Is Iran planning attacks on Americans; why is the US on alert?
english: US intelligence officials have warned that Iran is in the final stages of planning attacks against American personnel and diplomats stationed abroad. As a result, Washington has increased security measures and reduced its diplomatic staff in the Middle East. This rising tension occurs amid broader concerns about potential military escalations between the US, Israel, and Iran.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መረጃ ሰብሳቢ ኤጀንሲዎች ኢራን በውጭ አገር በሚገኙ የአሜሪካ ዜጎች እና ዲፕሎማቶች ላይ ጥቃት ለመሰንዘር በዝግጅት መጨረሻ ላይ እንደምትገኝ አስጠንቅቀዋል። በዚህም ምክንያት ዋሽንግተን በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያላትን የደህንነት ጥበቃ በማጥበቅ የዲፕሎማቲክ ሰራተኞቿን ቁጥር ቀንሳለች። ይህ ሁኔታ በአሜሪካ፣ በእስራኤል እና በኢራን መካከል ሊኖር የሚችለውን የወታደራዊ ግጭት ስጋት ይበልጥ አባብሶታል።
oromo: Ogeeyyonni oodeeffannoo Ameerikaa akka ibsanitti, Iraan biyyoota alaa keessatti lammiilee fi dippilomatoota Ameerikaa irratti haleellaa raawwachuuf qophii xumuraa irra geessetti. Kana hordofee, Washington giddu-galeessa bahaa keessatti eegumsa ishee cimsitee fi hojjettoota dippilomasii ishee hir’isteetti. Ta’iin kunis walitti dhufeenyi waraanaa Ameerikaa, Israa’elii fi Iraan gidduutti jiru gara fuulduraatti hammaachuu danda’a kan jedhu yaaddoo uumee jira.

title: Father who killed Oregon school gunman describes anguish over children he couldn't save
english: Kaylub Giamanco, who stopped a deadly shooting at an Oregon elementary school, has expressed deep sorrow over the victims he could not rescue. During the attack, which claimed the lives of three students and a teacher, Giamanco intervened after hearing children begging for help and witnessing the shooter's actions. While many consider him a hero, he feels guilty about the loss of life and hopes to offer comfort to the grieving families.
amharic: በኦሪገን አንደኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ቤት የተኩስ አድማውን ያስቆመው ካይለብ ጂያማንኮ፣ መታደግ ያልቻላቸውን ተጎጂዎች በማስታወስ ጥልቅ ሐዘን ተሰምቶታል። በወቅቱ በደረሰው ጥቃት ሶስት ተማሪዎች እና አንድ መምህር ህይወታቸው ሲያልፍ፣ ጂያማንኮ ህጻናት ሲማጸኑ በመስማቱ እና ተኳሹን በመመልከቱ ጣልቃ ገብቷል። ብዙዎች ጀግና ቢሉትም፣ የሟቾችን ቤተሰቦች በማጽናናት የራሱን የጥፋተኝነት ስሜት ለመግለጽ ይፈልጋል።
oromo: Kaylub Giamanco jedhamu nama mana barumsa sadarkaa tokkoffaa Ooregoniitti haleellaa hidhattootaa dhaabuu dhaan beekamu, namoota inni oolchuu hindandeenyeef gaddi guddaan itti dhaga'ameera. Haleellaa kana keessatti barattoonni sadii fi barsiisaan tokko yeroo ajjeefaman, Giamanco ijoolleen gargaarsa gaafachaa turuu dhaga'ee haleellicha dhaabuuf tarkaanfii fudhate. Namoonni hedduun akka gootaatti isa ilaalanis, inni garuu namoota du'aniif miira gadduu fi gaabbii keessa kan jiru yoo ta'u, maatii warra miidhamanii waliin gaddicha qooddachuu barbaada.

title: Why is Israel launching a new military operation in the occupied West Bank?
english: The Israeli military has initiated a major, multi-day operation across the occupied West Bank following a deadly checkpoint attack near Hebron. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu announced plans for widespread home demolitions, mass arrests, and forced displacements in areas linked to the suspects. Human rights groups have criticized the campaign, warning that these collective punitive measures may violate international law.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በሄብሮን አቅራቢያ በተፈጸመ የጥቃት ሙከራ ምክንያት በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ ሰፊ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ጀምሯል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የጥቃቱ ተጠርጣሪዎች በሚኖሩባቸው አካባቢዎች ቤቶችን እንደሚያፈርሱ፣ እስራዎችን እንደሚያካሂዱ እና ነዋሪዎችን እንደሚያፈናቅሉ አስታውቀዋል። የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ቡድኖች ይህ ድርጊት የጋራ ቅጣት በመሆኑ ዓለም አቀፍ ህግን ሊጥስ እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el miidhaa naannoo Hebronitti raawwatame hordofee, daangaa gara dhihaa (West Bank) keessatti duula waraanaa bal'aa jalqabaniiru. Ministirri Muummee Benyaamin Neetaanyaahuu, gandoota shakkamtoonni kun itti dhufan keessatti maneen akka diigamaniifi namoonni akka buqqaafaman ajajaniiru. Gareewwan mirga namoomaa duulli kun adabbii waloo ta'uusaatiin seera idil-addunyaa cabsuu akka danda'u akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Bolivian teachers strike over wages and education reform
english: Teachers across Bolivia have launched a national strike to protest against current salary levels and demand increased investment in the education sector. The educators are concerned that proposed government reforms to the curriculum could eventually result in the privatization of public schools. They are calling for immediate dialogue and better support to address their financial and professional grievances.
amharic: በቦሊቪያ የሚገኙ መምህራን ለደሞዝ ጭማሪ እና ለትምህርት ዘርፍ የላቀ በጀት በመጠየቅ አገር አቀፍ አድማ አድርገዋል። መምህራኑ መንግስት ያቀረበው የትምህርት ማሻሻያ ትምህርት ቤቶችን ወደ ግል ይዞታ ሊቀይር ይችላል የሚል ስጋት አላቸው። የትምህርት ዘርፉን ችግሮች ለመፍታትም መንግስት ከእነሱ ጋር በግልጽ እንዲወያይ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Barsiisonni biyya Booliiviyaa guutuu keessatti kaffaltii fooyyee fi baajata barnootaa dabaluu gaafachuun sochii dhaga'amuu eegalsiise. Barsiisonni kun jijjiirama barnootaa mootummaan dhiyeesse kun manneen barnootaa gara dhuunfaatti akka jijjiiraman sodaatu. Barsiisonni kun rakkoolee isaanii furuuf mootummaan marii akka godhuufi deeggarsa barbaachisu akka taasisu gaafachaa jiru.

title: The Muslims finding belonging in southern Spain
english: In southern Spain, a couple is establishing a community space called the House of Andalus to honor the region's historic Islamic heritage. Henrietta Szovati and her husband, Ajmal Masroor, are renovating a mountain farmhouse to reconnect people with both nature and this cultural legacy. This project highlights a growing trend of Muslims moving to Andalusia, where local place names and landscapes still echo the area's centuries-old Islamic past.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ስፔን የሚኖሩ ጥንዶች የአካባቢውን ታሪካዊ የእስልምና ቅርስ ለማስታወስ 'የአንዳሉስ ቤት' የተሰኘ ማዕከል እያቋቋሙ ነው። ሄንሪዬታ ስዞቫቲ እና ባለቤቷ አጅማል ማስሮር፣ የድሮ እርሻ ቤትን በማደስ ሰዎች ከተፈጥሮ እና ከታሪካዊ ባህላቸው ጋር እንዲገናኙ እየሰሩ ነው። ይህ ፕሮጀክት አሁንም ድረስ የአረብኛ ስያሜዎች እና አሻራዎች በሚታዩበት በአንዳሉስ ክልል ውስጥ የሚኖሩ ሙስሊሞች ቁጥር እየጨመረ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Sudaa Ispeen keessatti, heerumtootni lama 'Mana Andalus' jedhamuun bakka hawaasaa kan seenaa Islaamummaa naannichaa kabajju ijaaraa jiru. Henriyetaa Szoovaatii fi abbaan manaa ishee Ajmaal Masroor, mana qonnaa durii haaromsuun namoonni uumamaa fi aadaa isaanii waliin akka wal-qunnaman gochaa jiru. Hojiin kun, naannoo Andalus keessatti maqaa fi ragaaleen Islaamummaa durii ammallee mul'atanitti Muslimoonni baay'inaan qubachaa akka jiran ibsa.

title: Rubio calls on Cubans to partner with CIA ‘to create positive change’
english: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has publicly urged Cuban citizens to collaborate with the CIA to overthrow their government and push for political change. This appeal comes amid rising tensions and severe economic distress in Cuba, fueled by a US oil blockade and infrastructure failures. While the CIA has provided online instructions for potential recruits, Cuban officials have dismissed the call as a desperate and intrusive act.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ በኩባ የሚገኘውን ኮሚኒስት መንግስት ለመጣልና ለውጥ ለማምጣት የኩባ ዜጎች ከሲአይኤ ጋር እንዲተባበሩ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ይህ ጥሪ የቀረበው በአሜሪካ የነዳጅ ማዕቀብ እና በመሠረተ ልማት ችግሮች ምክንያት ኩባ በከባድ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ቀውስ ውስጥ ባለችበት ወቅት ነው። የኩባ ባለስልጣናት ይህንን የአሜሪካ ድርጊት ተስፋ የቆረጠ እና ጣልቃ ገብነት የተሞላበት ብለው ውድቅ አድርገውታል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Ameerikaa Maarkoo Ruubiyoon lammiileen Kuubaa mootummaa isaanii fonqolchuufi jijjiirama fiduuf jecha qaama qorannoo Ameerikaa (CIA) waliin akka hojjetan waamicha dhiyeessaniiru. Waamichi kun kan dhufe yeroo biyyattiin miidhaa diinagdee cimaa, akkasumas dhorkaa boba'aa Ameerikaan irratti feete irraa kan ka'e rakkoo keessa jirtuudha. Mootummaan Kuubaa garuu gocha kana aangoo malee biyya isaanii keessa seenuu fi gocha abdii kutannaa irratti hundaa'e jechuun balaaleffateera.

title: Chicago Bulls storm back from early deficit to beat Milwaukee Bucks in NBA
english: The Chicago Bulls defeated the Milwaukee Bucks with a score of 132-125 after overcoming a 15-point first-quarter deficit. Norman Powell and rookie Caleb Wilson led the Bulls' comeback efforts to secure their first win of the season. Despite a strong 34-point performance by Milwaukee's Tyler Herro, the Bucks suffered their second consecutive loss.
amharic: የቺካጎ ቡልስ ቡድን በመጀመሪያው ሩብ ሰዓት የነበረባቸውን የ15 ነጥብ ልዩነት በመቀልበስ ሚልዋውኪ በክስን 132 ለ 125 በሆነ ውጤት አሸንፈዋል። ኖርማን ፓውል እና አዲሱ ተጫዋች ካሌብ ዊልሰን ቡድናቸው የውድድር ዘመኑን የመጀመሪያ ድል እንዲቀዳጅ ትልቅ አስተዋጽኦ አድርገዋል። የሚልዋውኪው ታይለር ሂሮ 34 ነጥቦችን ማስመዝገብ ቢችልም፣ ቡድኑ በውድድር ዘመኑ ተከታታይ ሁለተኛ ሽንፈቱን አስተናግዷል።
oromo: Garee Chicago Bulls, tapha jalqabaa irratti qabxii 15 liqii ta'anii turan garagalchuudhaan Milwaukee Bucks 132 fi 125 mo'ataniiru. Norman Powell fi taphataan haaraa Caleb Wilson injifannoo kana galmeessisuuf gahee guddaa taphataniiru. Taphattuun Milwaukee Tyler Herro qabxii 34 ol baasuus, gareen isaa injifannoo dhabee tapha lammaffaa isaa itti aansuun mo'atameera.

title: Saudi-led coalition says it destroyed Houthi ballistic missiles fired towards Yanbu and Taif
english: The Saudi-led coalition successfully intercepted and neutralized two ballistic missiles launched by Houthi rebels towards the cities of Yanbu and Taif on Saturday. Local authorities briefly warned residents of potential risks in several major cities, including Mecca and Jeddah, but declared the danger over shortly after. This incident marks another escalation in the ongoing regional conflict.
amharic: በሳዑዲ የሚመራው ጥምረት በቅዳሜው ዕለት በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ወደ ያንቡ እና ጣኢፍ ከተሞች የተተኮሱ ሁለት የባለስቲክ ሚሳይሎችን ማክሸፉን አስታውቋል። የሳዑዲ ሲቪል መከላከያ በወቅቱ በሜካ፣ በጅዳ እና በሌሎች አካባቢዎች የነበረውን ስጋት ተከትሎ ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥቶ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ ከደቂቃዎች በኋላ ሁኔታው መረጋጋቱን አሳውቋል። ይህ ጥቃት በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ያለው ግጭት ተባብሶ መቀጠሉን ያሳያል።
oromo: Mootummaa Saudii durfamuun waraanni qindaa'een, rogeeyyoon Huutii magaalaalee Yanbuu fi Ta'if irratti boombiiwwan gurguddoo lamaa gadi lakkisan fashaleessuu isaa ibseera. Qaamoleen nageenyaa magaalota akka Makkaatii fi Jiddaah dabalatee akeekkachiisa yeroo gabaabaaf kennanii turan; garuu yeroo muraasa booda balaan tokkollee akka hin jirre ibsameera. Gochi kun walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa keessatti mul'atu kan itti fufe ta'uu isaa argisiisa.

title: Saudi civil defence issues 'potential danger' warning for Mecca, Jeddah
english: Saudi Arabia’s civil defense agency briefly issued emergency safety alerts for several western regions, including Mecca and Jeddah. Residents were advised to move to secure locations, though the warnings were cancelled shortly after they were posted. Officials also reminded the public not to distribute information or footage regarding defense operations against aerial threats.
amharic: የሳውዲ አረቢያ የሲቪል መከላከያ ኤጀንሲ መካን እና ጅዳን ጨምሮ በበርካታ ምዕራባዊ አካባቢዎች ለአጭር ጊዜ የደህንነት ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥቶ ነበር። ነዋሪዎች ወደ አስተማማኝ ቦታዎች እንዲሄዱ ቢመከሩም፣ ማስጠንቀቂያው ከጥቂት ደቂቃዎች በኋላ ተሰርዟል። ባለስልጣናቱ ህዝቡ ከአየር ላይ ስለሚሰነዘሩ ጥቃቶች የመከላከያ እርምጃዎችን የሚመለከቱ ምስሎችን ወይም መረጃዎችን እንዳያሰራጩ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Hojii gaggeessaan ittisa balaa biyya Sa'udii, magaala Makkaa fi Jiddaa dabalatee naannolee lixa biyyattii hedduuf akeekkachiisa hatattamaa dabarse ture. Jiraattonni iddoo nageenya qabu akka dhaqan kan gorfaman yoo ta'u, akeekkachiisichi erga darbee daqiiqaa muraasa keessatti haqameera. Qondaaltonni mootummaa, uummanni gocha ittisaa kanneen xiyyaara waraanaa ykn raaketaa irratti qopha'an ilaalchisee odeeffannoo ykn suuraa akka hin tamsaasne akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Gaza genocide leaves record number of orphans and widows
english: The ongoing conflict in Gaza has resulted in a devastating humanitarian crisis, leaving over 54,000 children orphaned and tens of thousands of women widowed. Many families, like the Abu Asser siblings, are left without stable shelter or resources, forcing them to rely on surviving relatives who are also struggling to survive. Local authorities report that thousands of children are now without any form of adult guardianship as the region faces extreme hardship.
amharic: በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለው ግጭት ከባድ የሰብአዊ ቀውስ የፈጠረ ሲሆን ከ54,000 በላይ ህጻናት ወላጅ አልባ እና በአስር ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሴቶች ባል አልባ ሆነዋል። እንደ አቡ አሰር ቤተሰቦች ያሉት ተጎጂዎች ቀጣይነት ያለው መጠለያ እና መሰረታዊ ድጋፍ ስለሌላቸው በችግር ውስጥ ካሉ ዘመዶቻቸው ጋር ለመኖር ተገደዋል። የሀገር ውስጥ ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት በአካባቢው በሚታየው ከፍተኛ ቀውስ ሳቢያ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ህጻናት ምንም አይነት ሞግዚት የሌላቸው ሆነዋል።
oromo: Waraana Gaazaa keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiruun rakkoo namummaa cimaatu uumamee, ijoolleen kuma 54 ol ta'an warra dhabanii, dubartoonni kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman ammoo abbaa manaa dhabaniiru. Maatiiwwan akka ijoollee Abu Asser, iddoo qubannaa fi gargaarsa gahaa hin qaban, kunis isaan firoota isaanii rakkoo keessa jiran irratti hirkachuuf isaan dirqisiiseera. Aangeyyoonni naannichaa akka ibsanitti, miidhaa cimaa kanaan walqabatee ijoolleen kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman eegduu tokkollee malee hafaniiru.

title: 'Accountability can't be swept under rubble': Amnesty on Gaza killings, aid
english: Amnesty International warns that lasting peace in Gaza requires strict adherence to international law and justice for victims rather than ignoring ongoing atrocities. The organization reports that over 1,400 Palestinians have been killed since the ceasefire period began, while millions struggle with homelessness, starvation, and a collapsed healthcare system. Amnesty emphasizes that the international community's failure to hold Israel accountable for defying court orders is directly contributing to continued mass-scale violence.
amharic: አምነስቲ ኢንተርናሽናል በጋዛ ዘላቂ ሰላም ለመፍጠር የአለም አቀፍ ህግጋትን ማክበር እና ለተጎጂዎች ፍትህ መስጠት ወሳኝ እንደሆነ አስታውቋል። ድርጅቱ እንደገለጸው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቱ ከተጀመረበት ጊዜ አንስቶ ከ1,400 በላይ ፍልስጤማውያን ተገድለዋል፤ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች ደግሞ ከመጠለያ፣ ከምግብ እና ከህክምና አገልግሎት ውጪ ሆነዋል። አለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ እስራኤልን ለፍርድ እና ለህግ ተገዢ እንድትሆን ማድረግ አለመቻሉ የጥቃት ተግባራት እንዲቀጥሉ ምክንያት ሆኗል ሲልም አክሏል።
oromo: Amnesty International nageenyi waaraan Gaaza keessatti akka dhufuuf seera idil-addunyaa kabajuu fi miidhamtootaaf haqaa kennuun murteessaa akka ta'e ibseera. Dhaabbatichi akka gabaasetti, yeroo walii-galtee dhaabbii waraanaa irraa eegalee namoonni Palastinii 1,400 ol ta'an ajjeefamaniiru, miliyoonaan kan lakkaa'aman ammoo mana malee, beelaan fi tajaajila fayyaa malee rakkachaa jiru. Hawaasni idil-addunyaa Israa'el seera idil-addunyaa akka kabajju gochuu dadhabuun isaa, gochi suukanneessaan kun akka itti fufuuf sababa ta'aa jira jedheera.

title: Morning update
english: Tensions in the Middle East have escalated following reports of attacks on commercial tankers near the Strait of Hormuz and intercepted aerial strikes against Saudi Arabia. Israeli forces conducted significant raids and demolitions in the West Bank while facing protests in Syria over military incursions. Meanwhile, geopolitical friction persists as U.S. leaders threaten military action against Iran and regional officials work toward diplomatic resolutions for ongoing conflicts.
amharic: በሆርሙዝ የባህር ዳርቻ የንግድ መርከቦች ላይ ጥቃቶች በመድረሳቸው እና ሳዑዲ አረቢያ ላይ የአየር ጥቃቶች በመሞከራቸው በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለው ውጥረት አድጓል። የእስራኤል ኃይሎች በዌስት ባንክ ወረራዎችን እና የህንፃዎችን መፍረስ ሲያካሂዱ፣ በሶሪያ ደግሞ ወታደራዊ ጣልቃ ገብነቶችን በመቃወም ተቃውሞዎች ተቀስቅሰዋል። ይህ በእንዲህ እንዳለ፣ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንደምትወስድ በማስፈራራት ላይ ስትሆን፣ ሌሎች የክልሉ ሀገራትም ለግጭቱ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ መፍትሄዎችን ለመፈለግ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Naannoo Handhuura Ormuzitti dooniiwwan daldalaa irratti miidhaan qaqqabuu fi Sa'udii Arabiyaa irratti weerarri qilleensaa yaalame hordofee, waldhabdeen biyyoota Giddu-galeessa Bahaa hammaateera. Humnoonni Israa'el naannoo West Baank keessatti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachaa fi mana jireenyaa diigaa jiru; gama biraatiin ammoo Suuriyaa keessatti mormiin weerara waraanaa Israa'el irratti geggeeffamaa jira. Yeroo ammaa kanatti, Ameerikaan Iran irratti tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhachuu akka dandeessu ergaa sodaachisaa dabarsaa jirti, biyyoonni naannichaa garuu waldhabdee kana furuuf karaa diippilomaasii fayyadamuuf yaalaa jiru.

title: France prepares for day of protest a week after nationwide riots
english: France is bracing for another wave of nationwide protests this Saturday, just one week after experiencing severe civil unrest. The government has deployed 70,000 police officers to maintain order and has placed strict limitations on where demonstrations can occur. Despite these security measures and warnings against violence, student groups and unions are moving forward with plans to gather in cities across the country.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ ከአንድ ሳምንት በፊት ከተከሰተው ከባድ ሁከት በኋላ በዚህ ቅዳሜ ሌላ ሀገር አቀፍ ተቃውሞ ለማስተናገድ እየተዘጋጀች ነው። መንግስት ሰላም ለማስከበር 70,000 የፖሊስ አባላትን ያሰማራ ሲሆን በተቃውሞ ቦታዎች ላይም ጥብቅ ክልከላዎችን ጥሏል። የፀጥታ እርምጃዎች ቢኖሩም የተማሪዎች ቡድኖች እና የሰራተኛ ማህበራት በተለያዩ የሀገሪቱ ከተሞች ሰላማዊ ሰልፎችን ለማድረግ ዝግጅታቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Faransaayiin torban tokko dura jeequmsa cimaa booda, Sanbata dhufu kana qarqara hiriira biyyoolessaa kaaniif of qophee jirti. Mootummaan nagaa eeguuf poolisoota 70,000 bobbaasee jira akkasumas iddoowwan hiriirri itti gaggeeffamu irratti dhiibbaa cimaa taasisee jira. Tarkaanfiiwwan nageenyaa kana hunda utuu jiruu, gareewwan barattootaa fi gamtaan hojjettootaa magaalota biyyattii garaa garaa keessatti hiriira bahuuf karoorfatanii jiru.

title: Woman, 65, becomes second patient to die of Ebola in Kenya
english: A 65-year-old woman has become the second person to die from Ebola in Kenya after contracting the virus from a relative. Authorities confirm that all current cases are contained within a single group, with no signs of the disease spreading among the general public. In response, Kenya has implemented stricter health screenings for travelers arriving from high-risk neighboring countries.
amharic: በኬንያ የኢቦላ ቫይረስ የተገኘባት የ65 ዓመት አዛውንት ህይወቷ አልፏል፤ ይህም በሀገሪቱ የሁለተኛዋ የኢቦላ ሰለባ ያደርጋታል። የጤና ሚኒስቴር እንደገለጸው ሁሉም የተያዙ ሰዎች በአንድ ቤተሰብ እና በቅርብ ግንኙነት ውስጥ ያሉ ናቸው እንጂ በሽታው በሰፊው አልተስፋፋም። ሁኔታውን ለመቆጣጠርም መንግስት ከተለያዩ ሀገራት ወደ ኬንያ በሚገቡ መንገደኞች ላይ ጥብቅ የጤና ምርመራ እያደረገ ነው።
oromo: Keeniyaatti dubartiin umriin isaanii waggaa 65 ta'e dhukkuba Iiboolaan kan du'an yoo ta'u, isaanis namoota biyyattii keessatti dhukkubichaan du'an keessaa lammaffaadha. Ministeerri fayyaa akka ibsetti, namoonni dhukkubichaan qabaman hundi maatii fi namoota dhihoo kan wal-qabataniidha, kanaafuu dhukkubichi hawaasa keessatti bal'inaan hin babal'anne. Tarkaanfii kana ittisuufis, mootummaan biyyoota ollaa irraa gara Keeniyaatti namoota dhufan hunda irratti qorannoo fayyaa cimaa gochaa jira.

title: Arrest made after fire at Hitler's Eagle's Nest retreat
english: German police have taken a person into custody following a significant fire at the Eagle's Nest, an Alpine retreat formerly used by Adolf Hitler. Approximately 200 emergency responders were deployed to battle the flames, though the site's challenging mountain location made firefighting efforts difficult. Fortunately, no injuries were reported, and authorities are currently investigating whether the detained individual was responsible for starting the blaze.
amharic: የጀርመን ፖሊስ በአዶልፍ ሂትለር የቀድሞ የዕረፍት ማረፊያ 'ኢግልስ ኔስት' ላይ በተነሳ የእሳት አደጋ አንድን ተጠርጣሪ በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል። ወደ 200 የሚጠጉ የነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች እሳቱን ለማጥፋት ቢሰማሩም፣ ቦታው በተራራማ አካባቢ መሆኑ ስራውን አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል። በደረሰው ጉዳት እስካሁን የሰው ህይወት ያለፈበት ዘገባ ያልወጣ ሲሆን፣ ባለስልጣናት ተጠርጣሪው በእሳት አደጋው ላይ ያላቸውን ግንኙነት እያጣሩ ይገኛል።
oromo: Poolisiin Jarmanii bakka boqonnaa durii Adolf Hitler itti fayyadamaa ture 'Eagle's Nest' irratti ibidda erga ka'ee booda namoota tokko to'annoo jala oolchaniiru. Hojjattoonni gargaarsa ariifachiisaa 200 ta'an ibidicha dhaamsuuf bobba'anis, bakki sun tulluu irra waan ta'eef dhaamsuun isaanii ulfaataa ta'eera. Miidhaan qaamaa namarra ga'e hin jiru; qaamoleen seeraas namni qabame sun ibidicha kaase ykn hin kaasin qulqulleeffachaa jiru.

title: Student movement takes Serbia's Vučić to the wire in neck-and-neck election
english: A student-led movement has emerged as a significant challenger to long-serving Serbian leader Aleksandar Vučić in the latest parliamentary elections. The group, formed following anti-corruption protests sparked by a deadly railway station accident, has fielded 250 candidates headed by professor Ilija Srdanović. While Vučić remains a powerful figure with a loyal base and strong economic record, this grassroots campaign represents his toughest political test in over a decade.
amharic: በሰርቢያ በተካሄደው የፓርላማ ምርጫ የተማሪዎች እንቅስቃሴ ለረጅም ጊዜ በስልጣን ላይ ለቆዩት አሌክሳንደር ቩቺች ጠንካራ ተፎካካሪ ሆኖ ብቅ ብሏል። ቡድኑ የተፈጠረው በኖቪ ሳድ ከተማ የባቡር ጣቢያ ጣሪያ መፍረስ እና የሙስና ተቃውሞዎችን ተከትሎ ሲሆን፣ ፕሮፌሰር ኢሊያ ስርዳኖቪች የሚመሩት 250 እጩዎችን አቅርቧል። ቩቺች በኢኮኖሚ እድገት እና በደጋፊዎቻቸው ዘንድ ተቀባይነት ቢኖራቸውም፣ ይህ የተማሪዎች ንቅናቄ ከ2012 ወዲህ እሳቸውን የሚገዳደር ትልቅ ሃይል ሆኗል።
oromo: Filannoo paarlaamaa Serbiyaa keessatti sochii barattootaa gaggeeffamaa jiru, hogganaa biyyattii yeroo dheeraaf tajaajilan Aleksandaar Vuuchichiif dorgomaa cimaa ta'ee dhiyaateera. Gareen kun kan hundaa'e balaa buufata baaburaa fi mormii mancaatii malaammaltummaa irratti hundaa'uun yoo ta'u, piroofeesar Iliya Srdanovich hogganamuun dorgomtoota 250 dhiyeessaniiru. Vuuchichi dinagdee fooyyessuu fi deggertoota cimaa qabaatanis, sochii barattootaa kana keessatti kanneen waggaa 2012 as isaan mudatan keessaa dorgommiin kun inni cimaa dha.

title: Trump administration sues to block certification of upcoming Alaska election
english: The Trump administration has filed a lawsuit attempting to stop Alaska from certifying its upcoming Senate election results if Republican incumbent Dan Sullivan loses. The government argues that having another candidate with the same name on the ballot could confuse voters and undermine the election's integrity. President Trump has publicly supported this legal challenge, claiming the second candidate's presence is a deceptive tactic intended to help the Democratic challenger.
amharic: የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በአላስካ የሴኔት ምርጫ ሪፐብሊካኑ ዳን ሱሊቫን ከተሸነፉ የምርጫ ውጤቱ እንዳይጸድቅ ክስ መስርቷል። መንግሥት በምርጫ ወረቀቱ ላይ ተመሳሳይ ስም ያለው ሌላ እጩ መኖሩ መራጮችን ግራ እንደሚያጋባ እና የምርጫውን ታማኝነት እንደሚጎዳ ይከራከራል። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የሁለተኛው እጩ መወዳደር ተቃዋሚን ለመደገፍ የታለመ ማታለል ነው በማለት ይህንን የህግ ክስ እንደሚደግፉ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Bulchiinsi Traamp Alaska keessatti yoo senatarri Rippabilikaanii Dan Sullivan mo'aman bu'aan filannoo akka hin raggaasifamne himata dhiheesseera. Mootummaan akka jedhutti, maqaan nama biraa walfakkaatu waraqaa filannoo irratti argamuun isaa sagalee kennitoota dogoggorsuu fi amanamummaa filannichaa miidhuu danda'a. Preezdaant Traamp duula kana kan deggaran yoo ta'u, dorgomaan inni lammaffaan filannoo kanaaf dhiyaachuun isaa mormituu Dimokraataatiif gargaarsa gochuuf kan karoorfameedha jedhaniiru.

title: Argentina identifies dozens of victims killed in its ‘Dirty War’
english: Forensic experts in Argentina have successfully identified the remains of 38 individuals who went missing during the country's military dictatorship. These victims were among the many people held at clandestine detention centers, such as the La Perla facility, during the era known as the 'Dirty War.' This effort represents a significant step in uncovering the truth about past human rights abuses.
amharic: የአርጀንቲና የፎረንሲክ ባለሙያዎች በአገሪቱ ወታደራዊ አገዛዝ ወቅት ጠፍተው የነበሩ 38 ሰዎችን አስክሬን መለየታቸውን አስታውቀዋል። እነዚህ ግለሰቦች 'ቆሻሻ ጦርነት' በሚል በሚታወቀው ወቅት ላ ፔርላ በተባለ ምስጢራዊ ማሰቃያ ማዕከል ታስረው የነበሩ ናቸው። ይህ ግኝት በወቅቱ የተፈጸሙ የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰቶችን ለማጋለጥ የሚደረግ ትልቅ ሂደት አካል ነው።
oromo: Ogeeyyonni foorensikii Arjantiinaa, yeroo bulchiinsa waraanaa biyyattii keessatti namoota baddanii turan 38 keessaa reeffa isaanii adda baasuu danda'aniiru. Namoonni kunneen yeroo 'Waraana Xuraa'a' jedhamee beekamu sanatti giddugala hidhaa iccitii 'La Perla' jedhamu keessatti dararamaa turani. Tarkaanfiin kun yakka mirga namoomaa yeroo sana raawwatame adda baasuuf gumaacha guddaa qaba.

title: Marco Rubio urges Cubans to collaborate with CIA to topple gov’t
english: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has called on the Cuban people to secretly partner with the CIA to overthrow their current government. This statement follows President Trump's warnings about deploying warships to the region amidst broader geopolitical tensions. These developments occur as Cuba continues to struggle with severe resource shortages caused by a long-standing American blockade.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ የኩባ ሕዝብ አሁን ያለውን መንግሥት ለመጣል ከሲአይኤ (CIA) ጋር በምስጢር እንዲተባበሩ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ይህ ጥሪ የተሰማው ፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ በአካባቢው የጦር መርከቦችን የመላክ ማስጠንቀቂያ ከሰጡ በኋላ ነው። ኩባ ላለፉት አሥር ወራት በአሜሪካ በተጣለባት ማዕቀብ ሳቢያ ከፍተኛ የኤሌክትሪክ እና የውኃ እጥረት እየገጠማት ትገኛለች።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Ameerikaa Maarkoo Rubiyoo, ummanni Kuubaa mootummaa isaanii buusuuf gargaarsa 'CIA' akka barbaadan waamicha dhiyeessaniiru. Waamichi kun kan dhufe, pirezidaant Traamp naannichatti doonii waraanaa erguuf erga doorsisanii booda. Kuubaan waggaa kudhaniif erga uggurri Ameerikaa irratti godhamee booda, dhabama humna ibsaa fi bishaanii cimaan mudatee jirti.

title: Israel raids towns, detains dozens of Palestinians in occupied West Bank
english: Following a deadly attack on two Israeli soldiers in Hebron, the Israeli military has launched extensive raids across at least 15 towns in the occupied West Bank. Dozens of Palestinians have been detained, and authorities have enforced a full lockdown that closes nearly 1,000 checkpoints, severely restricting movement for millions of people. Additionally, military forces have demolished buildings and ordered the evacuation of several families in the Hebron area as part of an ongoing multi-day security operation.
amharic: በሄብሮን ከተማ በሁለት የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ላይ የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት ተከትሎ፣ የእስራኤል ጦር በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ ቢያንስ በ15 ከተሞች ላይ ሰፊ ዘመቻ አድርጓል። በዚህ ወታደራዊ ኦፕሬሽን በርካታ ፍልስጤማውያን የታሰሩ ሲሆን፣ ወደ 1000 የሚጠጉ መተላለፊያ መንገዶች በመዘጋታቸው በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች እንቅስቃሴ ተገድቧል። በተጨማሪም የሄብሮን ነዋሪዎችን ቤቶች በማፍረስ እና በመፈናቀል የበርካታ ቀናት የጸጥታ ዘመቻ እየተካሄደ ይገኛል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el magaala Hebron keessatti waraana lama irratti haleellaa erga raawwatamee booda, naannoo daangaa Lixaatti magaaloottan 15 ol keessatti duula bal’aa gaggeessaa jira. Lakkoofsi namoota Falasxiin qabamanii baay’ee yoo ta’u, daandiiwwan 1,000 ol cufamuunsaanii namoota miliyoonaan lakkaawwaman irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumeera. Kana malees, waraanni Israa'el manneen jireenyaa diigee fi maatiileen akka gadi lakkisan ajajuun, duula nageenyaa guyyoota muraasa turu jalqabeera.

title: Pentagon designates Confucius Institutes a national security threat
english: The U.S. Department of Defense has officially labeled Confucius Institutes as national security threats, accusing them of serving as Chinese propaganda tools. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth reported that these organizations had continued to operate under different names at various universities after previous restrictions. Consequently, the Pentagon has successfully shut down 80 of these units to prevent the theft of intellectual property and foreign influence on students.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ኮንፊሽየስ ኢንስቲትዩቶችን ለብሔራዊ ደህንነት ስጋት እንደሆኑ በመፈረጅ በይፋ አግዷቸዋል። የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩ ፒት ሄግሴዝ እንደገለጹት፣ እነዚህ ተቋማት ቀደም ሲል በኮንግረስ በተጣለባቸው እገዳዎች ምክንያት ስማቸውን በመቀየር በዩኒቨርሲቲዎች ውስጥ በድብቅ ሲንቀሳቀሱ ቆይተዋል። ሚኒስቴሩ የአእምሮአዊ ንብረት ስርቆትን ለመከላከል እና የተማሪዎችን አስተሳሰብ ከመበከል ለመታደግ ሲባል በ30 ዩኒቨርሲቲዎች ውስጥ የነበሩ 80 ተቋማትን በዘዴ መዝጋቱን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Mummichi ittisa biyyaa Amerikaa dhaabbata 'Confucius Institutes' jedhaman sodaatti biyyaa akka ta'an labsii dabarsuun isaanis dhoorkee jira. Ministirri ittisaa Pete Hegseth akka ibsanitti, dhaabbileen kun ergama Chaayinaa raabsuuf jedhanii maqaa jijjiirrachuun yunivarsitiiwwan keessatti hojjachaa turan. Pentagooniin qabeenya sammuu hatuu fi sammuu barattootaa to’achuu dhaabuuf jechuun, dhaabbilee kanneen keessaa walakkaatti kan argaman 80 yunivarsitiiwwan gara garaa keessaa cuunfee jira.

title: Century-old mosque near Indian PM’s residence under gov’t threat
english: A mosque in New Delhi that has stood for over a century is facing the threat of demolition by the Indian government. The imam has reported receiving an eviction notice, while the building has already been disconnected from its water and electricity supplies. This incident is part of a larger, ongoing campaign of property demolitions in the neighborhood near the Prime Minister's residence.
amharic: በህንድ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር መኖሪያ አቅራቢያ የሚገኝ የአንድ መቶ ዓመት ዕድሜ ያለው መስጊድ በመንግስት ሊፈርስ እንደሚችል ተሰግቷል። የመስጊዱ ኢማም የማስለቀቂያ ደብዳቤ እንደደረሳቸው የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት የውሃና የኤሌክትሪክ አገልግሎት ተቋርጦባቸዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ መኖሪያ አካባቢ በመካሄድ ላይ ካለው ሰፊ የህንጻ ማፍረስ ዘመቻ ጋር የተያያዘ ነው።
oromo: Masjiidni waggaa dhibba tokkoo ol lakkoofsise kan magaala Niiw Delhii keessatti argamu, mootummaan Indiyaa diiguuf yaadaa jiraachuu gabaasameera. Imaamni masjiidichaa akka jedhanitti, iddoo sana gadhiisuuf xalayaan isaaniif gaheera; akkasumas tajaajilli bishaanii fi ibsaa masjiidichaa irraa adda citeera. Tarkaanfiin kun bulchiinsa ministeera muummee naannoo sanaatti kan godhamaa jiru, sochii manneen diiguu bal'aa ta'e keessaa isa tokko.

title: WHO announces start of Ebola vaccine clinical trial in DR Congo
english: The World Health Organization has launched a clinical trial in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to test the effectiveness of the Ervebo vaccine against the specific Ebola strain driving the current, widespread outbreak. This initiative, known as the Tumaini trial, aims to protect high-risk individuals and will soon evaluate two additional vaccines developed by Oxford and Moderna. This effort comes as the region faces its deadliest Ebola crisis to date, with cases now spanning four African nations.
amharic: የዓለም የጤና ድርጅት በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ እየተስፋፋ ያለውን የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ለመቆጣጠር አዲስ ክሊኒካዊ የክትባት ሙከራ ጀምሯል። 'ቱማኢኒ' (Tumaini) የተሰኘው ይህ ጥናት፣ ነባሩ የኢርቬቦ ክትባት በአሁኑ ወረርሽኝ ላይ ያለውን ውጤታማነት ለመፈተሽ እና ወደፊትም በኦክስፎርድ እና በሞዴርና የተዘጋጁ ሌሎች ክትባቶችን ለመሞከር ያለመ ነው። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በምስራቅ፣ መካከለኛው እና ምዕራብ አፍሪካ አገራት በስፋት እየተዛመተ ላለው እና እጅግ አስከፊ ለሆነው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ምላሽ ለመስጠት ነው።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Fayyaa Addunyaa (WHO) biyya Koongoo keessatti vaayirasii Iboolaa ittisuuf qorannoo talaallii haarawaa eegaleera. Qorannoon 'Tumaini' jedhamu kun, talaallii Ervebo jedhamu vaayirasii amma babal'achaa jiru kana irratti hojjetuu isaa kan qoratu yoo ta'u, gara fuulduraatti talaalliiwwan biroo kanneen Oksfoordii fi Moderna'n qopha'anis qorannoo kana keessatti kan hammataman ta'a. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame, weerarri Iboolaa kun biyyoota Afrikaa gara garaa keessatti daran hammaachaa waan jiruuf, lubbuu namoota baay'ee baraaruuf jedhameeti.

title: Iran war live: Israel launches ‘targeted’ Hebron operation after attack
english: Israeli military forces have initiated a focused operation in Hebron following a deadly shooting incident that resulted in the deaths of two soldiers. Meanwhile, global oil prices have spiked due to escalating regional tensions and concerns over potential new American strikes against Iran. US President Donald Trump has suggested the possibility of conducting further military actions against Iranian targets.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ሁለት ወታደሮች በተገደሉበት ጥቃት ምክንያት በሄብሮን ከተማ ውስጥ የተቀናጀ ወታደራዊ ኦፕሬሽን ጀምረዋል። በዚህ ቀጠናዊ ውጥረት ምክንያት የአለም የነዳጅ ዋጋ በከፍተኛ ደረጃ አሻቅቧል። የአሜሪካው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ኢራን ላይ ተጨማሪ ጥቃቶችን የመፈጸም እድል እንዳለ ፍንጭ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el loltoonni lama ajjeefamuun walqabatee magaalaa Heebroon keessatti duula waraanaa kan eegalan yoo ta'u, rakkoo naannichaa kanaan walqabatee gatiin boba'aa addunyaa dabalee jira. Gama biraatiin, pirezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp Iran irratti haleellaa biraa raawwachuu akka danda'an eeraniiru.

title: Macklemore: ‘I say free Palestine’ as he kicks off a new tour
english: Rapper Macklemore has officially launched his new tour, which he has titled 'Free Palestine,' to express his support for the Palestinian cause. This marks his first stage performance since he was removed from Ed Sheeran's tour lineup due to his previous pro-Palestinian remarks. During his return, the artist emphasized his commitment to human rights and his belief that supporting humanity should not be a complex issue.
amharic: ራፐር ማክለሞር ለፍልስጤም ያላቸውን ድጋፍ ለመግለጽ 'ፍሪ ፍልስጤም' (Free Palestine) የተሰኘ አዲስ የሙዚቃ ጉብኝት ጀምረዋል። አርቲስቱ ስለ ፍልስጤም በሰጧቸው አስተያየቶች ምክንያት ከኤድ ሽራን የሙዚቃ ጉብኝት ከተሰናበቱ በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ወደ መድረክ ተመልሰዋል። በዚሁ መድረክ ላይም ሰብአዊ መብትን መደገፍ እና የሰው ልጅ መብት መከበር ቀላል ጉዳይ እንደሆነ አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Rapariin beekamaan Maklemoor deeggarsa inni ummata Filisxeemiif qabu agarsiisuuf 'Free Palestine' jedhuun daawwannaasaa jalqabeera. Inni waa'ee Filisxeem yaada isaa ibsachuu isaatiin walqabatee, daawwanna muuziqaa Eed Shiiran irraa erga ari'amee booda kun deebi'ee sagantaa isaa irratti kan mul'ateefi. Maklemoor sagantaa isaa kanaan mirga namoomaa fi namummaan sadarkaa addunyaatti dhimma salphaa ta'uu isaa hubachiiseera.

title: Typhoon Champi hits Taiwan, killing one and injuring 350
english: Typhoon Champi recently struck Taiwan, resulting in one death and over 350 injuries while causing significant damage to infrastructure and power outages. Thousands of residents were forced to evacuate as authorities issued urgent warnings regarding destructive winds and heavy rainfall. The storm is now moving toward China and Japan, leading to widespread flight cancellations and ongoing emergency preparations across the region.
amharic: ታይፉን ቻምፒ በታይዋን በመምታቱ አንድ ሰው ህይወቱ ሲያልፍ ከ350 በላይ ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል፤ አውሎ ነፋሱ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ቤቶችን የኤሌክትሪክ አገልግሎት እንዲያቋርጥ እና የህዝብ መፈናቀልን አስከትሏል። ባለስልጣናት በአካባቢው አደገኛ የንፋስ እና የዝናብ ሁኔታ እንደሚቀጥል በማስጠንቀቅ ህዝቡ ቤት ውስጥ እንዲቆይ መክረዋል። አውሎ ነፋሱ አሁን ወደ ቻይና እና ጃፓን በማምራት ላይ ሲሆን በአካባቢው የረጅም ርቀት በረራዎች እንዲሰረዙ አድርጓል።
oromo: Obomboleettiin Champi jedhamu kan Taayowaan rukute lubbuu nam tokkoo kan galaafate yoo ta'u, namoota 350 oliif miidhaa qaamaa geessiseera. Obomboleettiin kun mana jireenyaa fi bu'uuraalee misoomaa hedduu kan mancaase yoo ta'u, namoonni kuma afur ol ta'an iddoo jireenyaa isaanii gadhiisuuf dirqamaniiru. Amma gara biyyoota Chaayinaa fi Jaappaanitti kan imalaa jiru obomboleettiin kun, balaliwwan xiyyaaraa hedduu akka haqaman taasiseera.

title: Kenya announces second Ebola death, says ‘no evidence’ of community spread
english: Kenya has reported a second fatality linked to an ongoing Ebola outbreak that originated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. While nine cases have been confirmed within a single specific group, health officials state that there is no indication of the virus spreading within the general community. Authorities are actively monitoring over one hundred individuals who had contact with the patients to prevent further transmission.

title: Freed US citizen was tortured in Russian jail, former Ukrainian prisoners say
english: Former Ukrainian prisoners who were held alongside 74-year-old American Stephen Hubbard have reported that he suffered severe physical abuse and humiliation in Russian custody. Witnesses claim guards frequently beat, electrocuted, and mocked Hubbard simply because he was a US citizen. Hubbard was eventually released after spending over four years in prison following his capture in Ukraine in 2022.
